decision_rule.admit_source_contract_only_if: All seven gates are satisfied by one already accepted local point-in-time source contract whose metadata can be bound without opening a source row or value.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: point_in_time_issuer_brand_product_identity
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: An accepted local source must expose stable listed-instrument, legal-entity, subsidiary, brand, product and trademark identifiers; ownership/association start and end intervals; name and portfolio changes; corporate actions; delistings; publication timestamps; and revision provenance for 2019-2023 without current-brand or current-product backfill.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: prevalue_query_basket_identity_and_ambiguity
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: The complete issuer-specific query basket must be immutable before observations, map every query to point-in-time issuer/brand/product identities, record aliases, language, spelling, generic-term ambiguity, collision and exclusion rules, and forbid query addition, deletion or reweighting after attention values.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: fixed_search_platform_geography_and_sampling_population
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: One search platform, geography, device/population scope, sampling frame, metric definition, normalization method and coverage policy must be fixed for the whole campaign. Platform, geography or measurement variants may not be selected after values.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: immutable_2019_2023_search_observation_archive
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: One accepted local archive must provide stable observation identity, query identity, observation interval, metric/unit, sampling metadata and complete immutable 2019-2023 history. The archive must be reproducible without reconstructing past observations from a current public interface.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: public_availability_sampling_and_revision_clock
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: Every identity and attention observation must have a signal-close public-availability clock, sampling/release cadence, delay, correction and revision chain proving what was knowable by each signal close; later restatements may not be backfilled.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: complete_all_issuer_zero_missing_denominator
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: The contract must enumerate every point-in-time eligible issuer, distinguish true zero attention from missing, unsupported or suppressed coverage, bind coverage changes and platform outages, and prove comparable all-issuer support throughout 2019-2023.

finite_contract_gate_catalog.name: later_formula_direction_support_and_walkforward_protocol
finite_contract_gate_catalog.required_contract: Only after gates one through six pass must the contract permit one exact formula, direction, aggregation across the frozen query basket, support/missing rule, t+1/t+3 clock, no-return gates and three frozen 2019-2023 expanding development folds to be bound before rows. The 2024-2025 interval remains once-only and closed until a frozen development survivor exists.

purpose: Perform one finite, zero-row, zero-network source-contract feasibility review for Campaign271 concept c271_01. This is not a factor definition, source acceptance, value audit, return trial or prospective activation.
timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical publication time after the Campaign271 final validated state; not a market-data timestamp or host-wall-clock claim.
